issuing_body: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
covered_actors: Not-for-profit organizations representing civil society and consumers
Organizations and individuals using the AI RMF

evidence.quote: NIST has developed the voluntary AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF) through a consensus-driven, open, transparent, and collaborative process.

implementation_notes: Administrative stakeholder-engagement webpage for the NIST AI RMF (originally published 2021-07-13 and updated through the January 26, 2023 launch of AI RMF 1.0). Summarizes NIST's workshops, RFI, draft consultations, and ongoing feedback mechanisms for revising the voluntary Framework, Playbook, Roadmap, and Crosswalks; contains no operative safety requirements or enforcement hooks.
